pages.text: Coffee Beans come from the Coffee Crop. Once the crop has grown, harvesting it gives you coffee beans.$(br2)Unlike the berries, the beans aren't the finished product - they are used to make Coffee.

pages.title: Coffee Beans
pages.text: These are used to make Coffee.$(br2)See $(l:whatsits:foods_drinks/juices_drinks)Juices & Drinks$(/l) for more.
